standard-dialogue.npc: Is it here? Is it there? Is it elsewhere?

standard-dialogue.player: I didn't know gates had relations.

standard-dialogue.npc: Oh yes. This one here - she is calm and boring. She stays here all the time. She doesn't like to move, but her sister is fidgety and refuses to stay in the same place for more than half an hour.

standard-dialogue.player: So where is the, errr, fidgety sister at the moment?

standard-dialogue.npc: Oh well. I don't know what you humans call these places. Let me show you.

standard-dialogue.text: Cutscene plays showing the location of the crop circle.
